greeting.message: We can't wait to celebrate this auspicious day with you, surrounded by the family and friends we love.

welcome.parents: With the blessings of our families
welcome.invite: invite you to their shubh vivah

venue.title: Vivah & Reception
venue.subtitle: Where we celebrate
venue.name: Samode Bagh
venue.mapAddress: Samode Bagh, Samode, Jaipur, Rajasthan, India

dress.title: Dress Code
dress.note: We'd love to see you in lehengas, sarees, sherwanis and kurtas. Part of the evening is on the lawn, so please choose comfortable footwear.

story.title: Our Story
story.text: We met at a family friend's wedding and fell in love over long conversations and even longer walks. With the blessings of our elders, we now begin the rest of our lives together.

program.title: Vivah Karyakram
program.note: The pheras will take place at the mandap on the lawn, followed by refreshments in the rose garden, before dinner and dancing in the durbar hall.

after.title: Griha Pravesh Lunch
after.subtitle: Join us the day after
after.name: The Garden Courtyard
after.text: Please join the family for a relaxed lunch the day after the wedding, as we welcome the bride home. Come as you are, and stay for food, music and memories of the night before. Children are welcome.

gifts.title: Shagun
gifts.text: Your blessings are the greatest gift of all. Should you wish to give shagun, a box will be available at the reception.

gallery.title: Our Moments
gallery.subtitle: A few memories from our journey so far, with many more to come.
